svg.title: IBM Maximo Application Suite in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Three of IBM's figures for Maximo Application Suite: a guided trial of two capabilities, Manage and Health; one entitlement of AppPoints for functionality and users; 10,000 field technicians supported by IBM Maximo at Transport for London. Each figure is IBM's, from its Maximo Application Suite and pricing pages. IBM does not state the trial's length, and states no period or measurement for the Transport for London figure.
